snippet.title: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty PS2 Intro and Music
snippet.description:
Intro and music for Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty on the PS2

European Release Date for PlayStation 2: March 8, 2002

Developer: Konami Computer Entertainment Japan[
Publisher: Konami

Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty is considered to be one of the greatest video games of all time. The game dealt with many themes, such as fake news and artificial intelligence, which put the game ahead of its time

The PS2 version got a 9.7/10 from IGN and 10/10 from PlayStation: The Official Magazine

Recorded from my PS2

What do you think of the intro and music? Leave a comment and rate it :)
Enjoy!
